title: Template -- Local email collection (mail store opened by a non-mail process)
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1114.001 (Email Collection: Local Email Collection). Outlook data files hold a user's full correspondence in one place, which makes them a standing collection target. Opening one is not itself notable -- Outlook does it constantly -- so the template keys on a mail store being read by something that is not a mail client or an indexing service, which is the shape a collection script or an archiver staging data takes. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
